usage.outputShape: body.summary, body.key_points[], body.entities[].{name,type}, body.sentiment.{label,score}, body.topics[], body.content_type, body.credibility_signals.{has_author,has_date,has_sources,word_count_adequate}, body.word_count, body.language
quirks: Input is a query parameter (url=), NOT a JSON body — it is a GET request.
The url value must be URL-encoded.
Optional strip_query=true removes query params from the target URL before processing.
usage.guide: Send a GET to https://content.hugen.tokyo/content/analyze with a single required query param `url` set to the (URL-encoded) page you want analyzed; optionally add strip_query=true to drop the target URL's own query string. Pay $0.02 USDC via x402 on Base (Solana also accepted). Response is a plain synchronous JSON object: read body.summary and body.key_points[] for the digest, body.sentiment for tone, body.topics[]/body.content_type for classification, body.entities[] for named entities, and body.credibility_signals for credibility flags.
